title: Local Uniform Finite Cyclicity of the $H_{14}^{3}$ Semihyperbolic Hemicycle in Quadratic Systems
summary: We prove local uniform finite cyclicity of the labelled $H_{14}^{3}$ hemicycle in a full neighborhood of its base field in the twelve-dimensional space of planar quadratic vector fields. Thus there is one fixed two-sided annular neighborhood of the compactified graphic in which the number of isolated limit cycles is bounded uniformly for every sufficiently close quadratic field.
